title: Planning the summer street-tree routes
titleZh: 規劃夏季行道樹巡護路線
passage:
From: Yara Dunn, Street Trees Office
To: Summer route leads
Subject: Next week’s street-tree work

We plan a second stop only where a first stop still gets the planned amount to the tree but that amount does not last until the next visit. If water from the first stop runs into the gutter, fix the way it is delivered before adding another stop.

The crew noted dry soil before this Monday’s round on both Cedar and Flint. On Cedar, water was still running into the gutter at the end of Monday’s dose. On Flint, all of Monday’s dose soaked in. I checked Flint again on Thursday, just before the next scheduled visit, and the soil around the roots was already dry.

Separately, we tried two types of mulch on newly planted trees: wood chips and shredded bark. Every tree in this trial had the same watering schedule. The crew counted fewer weeds around trees with bark overall. However, most of the bark trees were shaded by buildings, while most of the chip trees were in full sun.

The crew did keep counts for individual trees. Two shaded stretches each had trees with both types of mulch, installed in the same week. Each sunny stretch had only one type. Before recommending a switch, I want a comparison that does not simply repeat the difference in growing conditions.

One reminder about the orange clips: crews use them to mark trees that need a follow-up inspection. A clip is not a removal notice. Please take a clip off after recording the follow-up, even if the report recommends that more work be done later.
passageZh:
寄件者：行道樹管理處 Yara Dunn
收件者：夏季巡護路線領班
主旨：下週行道樹作業

只有在第一次澆水能讓樹木獲得預定水量，但撐不到下一次巡護時，我們才安排額外一趟。如果第一趟澆的水流進路邊排水溝，應先改善澆水方式，再考慮多跑一趟。

巡護人員發現，本週一澆水前，雪松街和燧石街的土壤都偏乾。雪松街的澆水作業結束時，水仍流進路邊排水溝。燧石街週一澆的水則全數滲入土中。週四，我在下一趟預定巡護前不久再次查看燧石街，發現根部周圍的土壤已經乾了。

另外，我們在新栽樹木上試用了兩種覆蓋材料：木片和碎樹皮。這項試驗的樹木都採用相同的澆水時程。整體來看，巡護人員在使用碎樹皮的樹旁數到較少雜草。不過，這些樹大多有建築物遮蔭，而使用木片的樹大多完全沒有遮蔭。

巡護人員確實有逐棵記錄雜草數。兩個有遮蔭的路段都同時有使用兩種材料的樹，材料皆在同一週鋪設。向陽路段則各只使用一種。建議更換材料前，我希望先做一項比較，不要只是重現原有的生長環境差異。

提醒一下：巡護人員用橘色夾子標記需要複查的樹木。夾子不是移除樹木的通知。記錄複查結果後就請取下夾子，即使報告建議日後再進行其他作業也一樣。
